== Summary ==
PC Errata 2016 disc card image of [[Vader's Lightsaber (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]]: PC Errata 2016 disc card (Players Committee card image with a bronze disc mark, starwarsccg.org card lists).

Source: Players Committee card image [http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Dark/large/vaderslightsaber.gif vaderslightsaber.gif] in the starwarsccg.org card lists. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160810084516/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Dark/large/vaderslightsaber.gif Internet Archive] (10 August 2016, the earliest archived copy); the same file was still served on 31 October 2026: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261031045830/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Dark/large/vaderslightsaber.gif Internet Archive].

Uploaded unchanged (SHA-1 <code>53feb30b87a728c05e068b08fbd6b69ff5393272</code>).

Fair use rationale: a low-resolution image of a Star Wars CCG card or errata slip (© Decipher Inc. / Players Committee, Star Wars © Lucasfilm Ltd.), used only to identify and study the card's errata on this non-commercial fan wiki; no free equivalent exists.
